question: Should Moldova expel Russia's ambassador, yes or no?

lines.text: A drone has flown over Moldova's capital, Chisinau, and Moldova closed its airspace.
President Maia Sandu says it was a Russian drone, one of several to violate Moldovan airspace this evening.

scene.quote: Several Russian drones violated our airspace

lines.text: The Defence Ministry says seven drones crossed into Moldova during Russia's latest attack on Ukraine.
It says five crashed near villages, one just eleven kilometres from Chisinau. No casualties were reported.
A possible sixth impact was reported in the Ocnita district, in the north.
The seventh vanished from monitoring near the town of Leova.
Moldova shut all its airspace at four twenty seven, Ukrainska Pravda says.
Border police then shut six crossings with Ukraine, including Ocnita and Otaci.
Sandu says Moldova does not have the defence capabilities to protect itself from drones.
She says Moldova will keep pushing for sanctions on Moscow.

scene.quote: We'll keep pushing for sanctions on Moscow

lines.text: Russia rejects the accusations, saying Moldova has no proof the drones are Russian.
Reuters says drones have rarely come this close to the capital.
Should Moldova expel Russia's ambassador, yes or no?
